newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian overnight money stable in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Indian overnight money stable in liquid market.

text.p: Indian overnight call money rates were stable at 3.50-4.0 percent on Wednesday, dealers said.
They said the oversubscribed portion of Tuesday's state development loan issue was returned to the banks, further easing the funds availability.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) received applications worth 28 billion rupees against the targeted amount of 16.09 billion rupees at Tuesday's loan.
Dealers expect the repos auction later on Wednesday to raise as much as 25 billion rupees at a cut off of 4.25-4.50 percent.
